name: Report Back to Fizzlebub
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
That Fool's Stout worked great!  I placed a bet on the next race, and... let's hope the crew you got drunk did a number on their car!

There's only one more task for you -- take this note back to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.  He'll want to know of the successful test.

And hopefully we can get more of that Fool's Stout for future races!
narrative.objectives: Bring the Fool's Stout report to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText:
It says here that the fool's stout was a success. That's good news!

If you ever want more of the stuff, then let me know and I'll have you gather more of Zanzil's Mixture.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello adventurer. How'd that stout work out? It's strong stuff, isn't it?
